title: bro plan — next
description: Structural contract for a `kind = "next"` TOML plan — the parsed document `parseNextPlan` (packages/cli/src/commands/next-plan.ts) consumes. Cross-field rules stay in that validator: filters.match must compile as a regex.

version.description: Schema pin — must not exceed NEXT_PLAN_VERSION (latest: 1)

claim.description: false = selection only — nothing is claimed

gates.description: forbid (default) keeps HUMAN GATE beads out of the claimable queue

scope.description: project (default) claims only under this checkout's issue_prefix

types.description: issue_type allowlist — epics and molecule steps stay excluded regardless

match.description: Case-insensitive regex over the title — must compile (validator-checked)

labels.description: Any-of label scope — a bead must carry at least one
